name: web-design-guidelines
title_zh: 对照 26 条 Web 界面规范逐项审 UI 代码
tagline_zh: 说一句「审下我的界面」，它按 Web Interface Guidelines 逐条过：可点区域够不够大。
tagline_en: Say "review my UI" and it checks against 26 concrete rules: tap targets, focus visibility, contrast. No vibes.
desc_en: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
why_zh: 把散落在各处的规范收成一份可执行清单，逐条扫代码并给出具体行号与修改建议。不是泛泛而谈。
why_en: Turns scattered best practices into one executable checklist, scanning code line-by-line with specific fixes. A concrete health.
limit_zh: 只审 HTML/CSS/JS 前端代码，不覆盖设计稿、Figma 文件或后端逻辑；产物是问题清单与建议，不自动改代码。
limit_en: Only audits HTML/CSS/JS frontend code, not design files or backend. Outputs findings & suggestions, doesn't auto-fix. Requires internet for spec.
title_en: Audit UI code against 26 web interface guidelines
